PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 379
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 379
ACT XL OF 2021
UNIVERSITY OF LAHORE (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the University of
Lahore Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th November, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(81)/2021/2691, dated 24.11.2021.---The University of Lahore (Amendment) Bill, 2021, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 23, 2021, and assented to by
the Governor of the Punjab on November 23, 2021, is hereby published as an Act
of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance
LXI of 2002) in the manner hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---This Act
may be cited as the University of Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance LXI of 2002

2. Amendment
in section 2 of Ordinance LXI of 2002.---In the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance LXI of 2002),
hereinafter referred to as 'the Ordinance', in section 2:
(i) clause
(d) shall be omitted; and
(ii) the
word "and" appearing at the end of clause (k) shall be omitted and
after clause (k), the following new clause (kk) shall be added:
"(kk)
"Trust" means the Ibadat Educational Trust; a Trust established under
the Trusts Act, 1882, the sponsoring body of the University; and"

Amendment in section 4 of Ordinance LXI of 2002

the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 23, 2021, and assented to by

of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the University of Lahore Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance
LXI of 2002) in the manner hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of Punjab as follows:
3. Amendment
in section 4 of Ordinance LXI of 2002.---In the Ordinance, in section 4:
(a) in
clause (a), for sub-clauses (i) and (ii), the following shall be substituted:
(i)
"the. Faculties of Sciences, Social Sciences, Arts and Architecture, Law, Information
Technology, Management Sciences, Medicine and Dentistry, Allied Health Science,
Pharmacy, Engineering and Technology and Languages and Literature; and
(ii) such
other branches of knowledge and Faculties as the Board may determine with the
approval of the Patron given on the recommendation of a committee constituted
by the Board and, where applicable, subject to the prior approval of the
relevant statutory body of a professional education.
Provided
that the Board shall be competent to approve departments on the recommendation
of Academic Council for the approved Faculties subject to the prior approval of
the relevant statutory body of a professional education, where
applicable."
(b) in
clause (f), before the word "education", the word "higher"
shall be inserted.

subsection (2), the word "Company" shall be substituted by the word
